tidbit: Did you know… about 11,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
An ad-powered artificial intelligence startup worth 15 billion dollars is already in use at doctor's offices, according to Ars Technica. Reported by Ars Technica: The 15 billion dollar startup powers medical practices across the country.
Who's paying for the artificial intelligence build-out? Probably you, reports Financial Times. Reported by Financial Times: the costs of artificial intelligence infrastructure fall to consumers and businesses alike.
ServiceNow and Nvidia launched Arc, a personal long-running enterprise artificial intelligence agent for productivity tasks across email and Teams, for RTX Spark and Nvidia OpenShell. Reported by techmeme dot com: ServiceNow and Nvidia's Arc agent handles enterprise productivity across multiple platforms.
Claude Code permissions turn artificial intelligence coding into a controlled security workflow, reported by meetcyber dot net. Reported by meetcyber dot net: Claude Code permissions create security controls for artificial intelligence coding tasks.
Claude Mods flips the harness inside out, according to latent dot space. Reported by latent dot space: Claude Mods fundamentally changes how the coding harness operates.
Free every hour.
